title: Come On Baby Light My Fire
description: Why are covers of "Light My Fire" so good? Why is there a cover in almost every genre?

title: feat. Mark Svenvold & Ted Sabety aka Xn0rml
description: The minds behind You, Me and the Algorithmic — an album that stitches trip-hop beats to Euro-disco, Appalachian preacher cadences to punk guitar, and spoken-word poems sampled back into themselves, all run through analog modular synths and samplers that still take 3.5" floppies. We're playing music from the new album, songs that influenced its development, and maybe a few other original works.

title: All Vinyl Freeform 10th Anniversary Mix
description: Live from Freeform's Studio on SE Stark for their 10th anniversary doing an all vinyl set.

title: Oliver Cheatham → Cuban Percussion → MF DOOM → Robin Williams
description: Drawing lines from Oliver Cheatham to Cuban percussion to MF DOOM to Robin Williams rapping on the FernGully soundtrack, which somehow makes sense when you hear it.

title: feat. Don Haugen, Scot Jenerik, Austin Rich & Aurora Josephson
description: Joined by musicians performing at the Portland Arts Collective: Don Haugen, Scot Jenerik, Austin Rich, and Aurora Josephson. Two hours of experimental music.

title: feat. Sean Russell Hallowell aka Isorhythmics
description: Joined by composer, video artist, teacher and all around modern renaissance man Sean Russell Hallowell aka Isorhythmics. New album Delicate Citadel — we'll play some tracks, talk influences, and dive into some medieval chamber music.

title: CG+E w/ Big Montana: Nom de Plumes, Alter Egos & Side Projects
description: A one-off special featuring our good friend Big Montana, covering pen names, pseudonyms, alter egos, spinoffs, side projects... whatever you want to call the sounds that musicians make behind the veil of another name.

title: feat. Andres Botero
description: A special guest all the way from Vancouver, BC — photographer and zine creator Andres Botero takes us on a journey through the Vancouver electronic music scene.

title: We Forgot to Write a Description
description: You'll just have to trust us.

title: It's All About Madonna... I Think... Mostly?
description: This week it's all about Madonna... I think... mostly?

title: ZE Records & Warp Records Retrospective
description: An hour of ZE and an hour of WARP with everything from Lydia Lunch to Yves Tumor.

title: Spirtitual Songs (Kind Of)
description: Gospel music has influenced a lot more popular music than you may think. Rock with us as we try to unpack this in two hours.

title: The Cabin in the Sky Special Pt. 2
description: The second part of our De La Soul special.

title: The Cabin in the Sky Special Pt. 1
description: The first part of our De La Soul special. Winds up that if you play more than three songs by one artist on MixCloud, they won't let you post it. So you get two parts.

title: The Vinyl Grab Bag Show
description: We grabbed a stack of records at random and played what came out. Turns out in December that means a lot of holiday vinyl — Esquivel, Run-D.M.C., Kurtis Blow, Sharon Jones & the Dap-Kings. We're not complaining.

title: Staring at Shoelaces
description: Two hours of shoegaze. Don't catch a neck cramp.

title: The Christmas Special
description: Jingly jing, eyyy awww eyyy awww, it's Dominic the Donkey.

title: The mellow sounds of the Quiet Storm
description: Two hours of the silkiest late-night R&B, soul, and smooth grooves we could find — Sade, Anita Baker, Toni Braxton, Luther, Bobby Caldwell, Marvin Gaye. An episode to listen to with the lights low.

title: feat. A$AP Pocky
description: Maybe our favorite episode of all time. This one features guest DJ A$AP Pocky for an hour of City Pop education.

title: Guest Hosting "Normal Carpet Ride"
description: We took the wheel of Normal Carpet Ride for a special guest session, bringing our take on new jack swing, early 90s R&B, and the sounds that defined the decade.

title: Guest Hosting "In The Dog House"
description: We had a chance to spin some tracks during safe harbor hours over at Freeform. With this one, we're going back into the crates, hitting everywhere from PNW to Paris to CG's longtime home of Long Island.

title: Blaxploitation Soundtracks
description: In São Paulo, I had a chance to visit SP na Onda do Break at Sesc 24 de Maio. A whole section was dedicated to Blaxploitation posters, and thus the inspiration for this episode.

title: Loggins → Shit Robot → Wang Chung → Bobby Womack
New Jersey is the center of the universe... ask Whitney
Roy Ayers → Houston → Chicano Soul
description: A meandering path from hip hop and jazz to Chicano soul.

title: Jazz Fusion → Do The Bartman → Dub Reggae → UK Garage
description: We weren't really writing descriptions when we started doing this show, but I know for certain that we played some UK Garage.

title: The First Episode
description: It all had to start somewhere.
